issues.description: The particle 'à?' sounds like the speaker already expects the answer. It is natural in spoken Vietnamese, but a neutral yes/no form is clearer for A2 learners.
issues.suggested_fix: Cuối tuần này bạn có định đi xe buýt không?

issues.description: 'chuyến đi xe buýt lên núi' is understandable, but the noun phrase is a little packed. Putting the means of transport after the destination makes it clearer.
issues.suggested_fix: Ừ, chuyến đi lên núi bằng xe buýt của bọn mình sẽ tuyệt lắm đấy.

issues.description: The Vietnamese gloss for 'weekend' gives the days but leaves out the idea that many people do not work on those days. It is not wrong, but adding this would match the English gloss better.
issues.suggested_fix: cuối tuần (thứ Bảy và Chủ Nhật, thường là ngày nghỉ)

issues.description: The English gloss for 'bus' says 'a big car'. For learners, 'vehicle' is more accurate. The Vietnamese gloss could also include a short explanation.
issues.suggested_fix: en: a big vehicle that carries many people on the road; vi: xe buýt (xe lớn chở nhiều người trên đường)

qa_report.summary: The micro-dialogue is clear and fits A2. The target and review words appear, and the Vietnamese is mostly natural. I would approve after small fixes: make the first question more neutral, simplify the second noun phrase, and make the weekend/bus glosses a little more complete.
